Step 1: Online Application.
Accomplish the LSPU Online Application (portal: https://admissions.lspusys.com/). Make sure to input true and correct information on the required fields properly.

Check email for the schedule of examination to be sent by the Admission/Guidance Office. Note: Make sure that the email address to be used in the application is correct and active.

trace.answer_for_eval:
To apply online for the completion of an INC grade at LSPU-LB campus, follow these steps:

1. Submit the complete requirements to the subject teacher.
2. Log in to your portal in the LSPU online system.
3. Pay the corresponding completion fee of P30.00 per unit at the cashier’s office, and the cashier will put the OR number on the completion form.
4. Inform the subject teacher that you have applied online for the completion of your INC or 4.0 grade.
5. The subject teacher will give the corresponding grades through the online system.
6. The college dean or associate dean will check and approve the request for completion/removal.
7. The registrar will verify if the grade has been changed.

Total time for the process is approximately 25 minutes.
